summary: TLGY Acquisition Corp. filed an 8-K reporting a second amendment to its business combination agreement with StablecoinX Inc. and related entities, extending the outside date from April 21, 2026 to July 21, 2026. This is a de-SPAC transaction where TLGY, a Cayman Islands SPAC, will be acquired and merged into StablecoinX, which will become publicly traded. No price, premium, or advisor names are provided. The extension gives additional time to close the transaction, which requires shareholder approval. The risk-arb angle is monitoring the merger vote and redemption levels.
